historical_anchor: Historically USS Flying Fish sighted Ozawa force in/near San Bernardino Strait on 15 Jun and reported it; USS Seahorse separately sighted a battleship/cruiser force, giving Fifth Fleet strategic warning.
Historical US submarines were normally ordered to report major fleet sightings before pressing an attack when the strategic value of contact outweighed a low-percentage shot.

branch_contacts.morning_recontact: A US submarine reacquires a carrier/heavy-ship echelon east of the Philippine exit approaches. Visual/radar fragments support at least several carriers plus major surface escorts, but staggered Japanese formations prevent a single complete count.
branch_contacts.afternoon_independent_contact: A second submarine obtains a separate heavy-unit contact on a more southerly/trailing echelon. Large battleship silhouettes and cruiser/destroyer screen are reported.
branch_contacts.combined_assessment: By evening Spruance/Mitscher can treat a major Japanese carrier-battleship sortie as CONFIRMED. Working estimate is multiple fleet carriers plus numerous secondary carriers and at least five-to-seven battleships; exact eleven-carrier branch total remains unresolved.
branch_contacts.track_freshness: Best directional/speed solution is normally 4-8 hours stale by the time it is fused at fleet headquarters. There is no continuous submarine shadow track suitable for immediate carrier strike launch.

attack_gate.reason: Reporting/recontact is prioritized; deeper Japanese destroyer/air ASW screen and staggered formations make prolonged periscope shadowing costly. No free historical shot is invented.

Spruance_effect.carrier_disposition: Keep three fast-carrier task groups, about twelve fast decks, in the Saipan/Philippine-Sea protection system. Only one roughly four-deck group is permitted to continue the Bonins suppression mission, with an early-return instruction after the 15 Jun contact sharpens.
Spruance_effect.transport_policy: Amphibious transports and vulnerable logistics begin eastward night withdrawal/dispersion once unloading priorities permit.
Spruance_effect.operational_choice: Do not dash TF58 west on a stale submarine bearing. Primary mission remains covering the Saipan lodgment and preventing a Japanese surface/carrier breakthrough.
